mechanisms.name: crack deflection and branching
mechanisms.material_state: annealed at 1973 K for 48 h, furnace cooled

evidence.quote: Kim et al.,5) have reported that the beneficial effect of 5Hf-5C addition could result from the existence of Nb carbide dispersoids as well as Nb5Si3 phases, which causes the crack deflection and branching through the interphase-debonding between Nb solid-solution and Nb carbide dispersoids or Nb5Si3 and Nb solid-solution.
Instead, based on a stress exponent n of ~1, and the activation energy for creep, Qc, it, has been suggested that creep of Nb5Si3 probably occurs by the Nabarro-Herring mechanism.

Considering the Qc value of this alloy and the reported values of activation energy for diffusion of molybdenum and tungsten in niobium, 511 kJ/mol and 653 kJ/mol, respectively,18) it seems that the creep process in this alloy is rate-controlled by the diffusion of tungsten in the Nb solid-solution.
